companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We're a next-gen XDR product that leverages data from all points of the organization using cutting-edge big data frameworks, advanced ML pipelines, and unparalleled cybersecurity insights to deliver the future of cyber prevention, detection, and response.  

We're looking for a highly motivated and talented Full Stack Engineer to join our growing core team in a start-up-like environment that will help design, develop, and deliver our novel cyber security solution.

  • Build new and exciting components in an ever-growing and evolving XDR to provide scale and productivity.
  • Rapidly deliver high-quality, scalable, enterprise-ready SaaS application.
  • Take part in decision-making, architecture design & technology research.
  • Drive infrastructure initiatives and implement robust and scalable solutions.
  • Make design decisions on the basis of performance, scalability, and future expansion.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• At least 4 years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • Experience with Node.js and react
  • BSc in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent knowledge.
  • Deep understanding of computer science principles, design patterns, and high-level analytical skills.
  • Experience with Rest API, No-SQL databases, Microservices, and highly scalable systems.
  • Experience with JavaScript, CSS, HTML (latest versions).
  • Deep familiarity with cloud infrastructures and architectures.
  • Team Player, accountable, dedicated, and passionate about coding standards.
  • Eager and able to quickly master new technologies.
